capability.summary: Reasoning model for sustained coding, research, and document workflows.
capability.problem_space: Reasoning model for sustained coding, research, and document workflows. Applicable tasks include multi-file code revision, multi-step research synthesis, document drafting, visual evidence interpretation. Accepts text, image input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.

env_requirements: Endpoint exposing the documented model through Chat Completions; gateway mapping unverified
Valid API key for the selected service or an explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint
Endpoint and transport support for every requested input and output modality
The source URI is a proposed relay interface, not evidence of native OpenAI protocol support.
Forced tool use is rejected by the documented native model. Tool-choice probes must respect this restriction.
Thinking blocks cannot be freely replayed to earlier models; review cross-model continuation before activation.
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.

provenance.task_profile_basis: Neutral candidate task categories based on documented operations; not an empirical model ranking or fixed role assignment.
